contentList.content: Zephra is deadliest before the fight can answer. Against a creature that has not taken a turn yet, she has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>, and any successful roll is a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.
Once per combat, at the start of her turn, the wind buys Zephra a moment more: she gains an additional <LSTag Tooltip="Action">action</LSTag> until the end of that turn.
The wind has bought Zephra a moment more. She has an additional <LSTag Tooltip="Action">action</LSTag> until the end of this turn.
Zephra steps onto the wind and reappears elsewhere nearby. The wind stays at her back: she gains <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_ZEPHRA_TAILWIND">Tailwind</LSTag> until the end of her turn.

The wind gathers at the Windborne's back. Until the end of her turn she has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>, and every successful roll is a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.
